description: The existing small curled ends of this single painted shape softly bend a few pixels sideways, then return. Its broad lower body stays pinned in exactly the same position. The whole shape keeps its original flattened height and horizontal footprint. One smooth restrained sway. Maintain constant color, light and opacity. Nothing grows, appears, breaks away or disappears. Fixed camera and transparent background.
subject_description: One small flattened orange and yellow curved painted brushstroke on transparency
initial_pose: A low horizontal painted silhouette with a fixed broad lower body and softly curved small upper ends
